envelope.description: Pager: older pages, load requests and the bar

body.title: Pager: older pages, load requests and the bar
body.summary: Extend the pager with: prepend(page), which discards a page that does not match the shown session and first held index, records scrollTop and scrollHeight, renders the page through the registry (keys r<absolute index>, pending rows isolated, following off, cleared in a finally), moves the new nodes above the held ones and restores the reader's place; the load request with its one-at-a-time flag, cleared on the matching page, on reset and after 5 seconds; the scroll listener that requests a page at the top and runs the trim on return to the bottom; and the 'load earlier' bar, shown when the first held index is above 0, with the count of older rows.
acceptanceChecks: prepend renders an older page above the held rows in order, keyed r<absolute index>; scrollTop grows by exactly the height added and the view never jumps to the bottom
A page for another session or with the wrong `before` adds no row
Trimmed rows render again when their page comes back
One load-older is sent per request (bar click or scroll to the top); none while loading; the flag clears on the matching page, on reset and after 5 seconds
Returning to the bottom above 300 held rows runs the trim
A row that throws while a page renders falls back and following is switched back on
The bar is shown only when the first held index is above 0 and names the count of older rows

tests.name: pager prepend: an older page is rendered above the held rows in transcript order, keyed r<absolute index>; scrollTop grows by exactly the height added and the view is never moved to the bottom while the page renders
pager prepend: a page for another session, or whose before is not the first held index, is discarded and adds no row
trimmed rows render again when their page comes back: the dropped keys are forgotten, so appendKeyed renders new nodes

pager load request: one load-older is sent for the first held index on a bar click or a scroll to the top; no second request is sent while one is loading; the flag clears on the matching page, on a restore and after 5 seconds
returning to the bottom with more than 300 rows held runs the trim from the scroll listener
a row that throws while an older page renders falls back, and following is switched back on afterwards
the 'load earlier' bar is shown only when the first held index is above 0, names the count of older rows, and appears after a trim
